saw_lines: Buyers of export 4x4s compare landed price, shipping time and customs paperwork, and they won’t commit until the total is clear.
So sales are won or lost in the Google ad, where buyers decide whether this seller is worth a call.
Your 299 Google creatives run 22 text and 18 image formats, so rewrite the text ads around one landed price and a delivery time.
ads_1: Google text ads built on landed price, delivery time and customs clarity
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Tiktok
